name: Purge
description: Reduce interaction friction: inject a tail-end directive into user messages so the agent executes to completion instead of stopping to ask, with idempotent de-duplication and per-preset control.

almaPurge.enabled.description: Master switch. When off, no injection happens at all.

almaPurge.preset.description: How forceful the injected directive is. minimal = stop asking; standard = stop asking + finish the task; strict = adds an explicit anti-hedging clause.

almaPurge.boost.description: Append an extra short reinforcement line at the very end. Longer directives get diluted; this keeps the last thing the model reads on-topic.

almaPurge.customInstructions.description: Extra instructions appended after the preset text.

almaPurge.debug.description: Log every injection decision (injected / skipped / why).
